bullets.id: Emas spot nyaris datar di sekitar $4.167,90 pada akhir Jumat (−0,05%), gagal bertahan setelah sempat mendekati $4.200 di sesi Asia. Ketua Fed Kevin Warsh di Bangkok menolak memberi sinyal kebijakan ("tidak mau pre-judge rapat"), sementara produksi industri September naik 0,7%, di atas perkiraan, dan harga impor naik 8,1% yoy, terbesar sejak Juli 2022.
bullets.en: Spot gold was nearly flat near $4,167.90 late Friday (−0.05%), failing to hold after nearing $4,200 in the Asian session. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh declined to signal policy in Bangkok ("I don’t believe in pre-judging meetings"), while September industrial production rose 0.7%, above expectations, and import prices rose 8.1% y/y, the largest since July 2022.

bullets.id: Peluang Fed menahan suku bunga pada 27–28 Oktober naik ke sekitar 83% dari 72% pada Kamis, tetapi pasar masih melihat peluang tinggi kenaikan pada Desember. Yield 10 tahun pulih ke sekitar 5,12%, Brent ditutup $109,86 dan WTI di atas $100 untuk pertama kali sejak September. Emas turun sekitar 4% sebulan dan sekitar 26% di bawah rekor Januari $5.608.
bullets.en: Odds of a Fed hold at the October 27–28 meeting rose to about 83% from 72% on Thursday, but markets still see a high chance of a December hike. The 10-year yield recovered to about 5.12%, Brent settled at $109.86 and WTI topped $100 for the first time since September. Gold is down about 4% on the month and about 26% below its January record of $5,608.

bullets.id: Kitco menandai resistance di $4.176 dan zona $4.185–$4.201, lalu $4.218 dan $4.240. Support di $4.148, $4.132 dan $4.111; terendah pekan ini sekitar $4.073 setelah CPI. Pekan depan: housing starts (Selasa), klaim pengangguran (Kamis), sentimen konsumen final (Jumat), lalu FOMC 27–28 Oktober dan PCE September pada 29 Oktober.
bullets.en: Kitco marks resistance at $4,176 and a $4,185–$4,201 zone, then $4,218 and $4,240. Support sits at $4,148, $4,132 and $4,111; this week’s low was about $4,073 after CPI. Next week: housing starts (Tuesday), jobless claims (Thursday), final consumer sentiment (Friday), then the October 27–28 FOMC and September PCE on October 29.

bullets.id: Antam naik Rp7.000 ke Rp2.572.000/gram, kenaikan hari kedua; buyback naik Rp12.000 ke Rp2.387.000, spread Rp185.000 (sekitar 7,2%). Galeri24 naik Rp8.000 ke Rp2.517.000 (buyback Rp2.369.000, spread sekitar 5,9%) dan UBS naik Rp8.000 ke Rp2.541.000 (buyback Rp2.343.000, spread sekitar 7,8%).
bullets.en: Antam rose Rp7,000 to Rp2,572,000/gram, a second daily gain; buyback rose Rp12,000 to Rp2,387,000, a Rp185,000 spread (about 7.2%). Galeri24 rose Rp8,000 to Rp2,517,000 (buyback Rp2,369,000, spread about 5.9%) and UBS rose Rp8,000 to Rp2,541,000 (buyback Rp2,343,000, spread about 7.8%).
